message.content:
Emerald green velvet long-sleeve blouse with a structured peplum waist and wide lapels, #0a5f36, cut tailored to accentuate the silhouette while allowing ease of movement.
High-waisted midi skirt in metallic champagne satin with subtle fluid draping, #e8dcb9, A-line cut that flows gracefully from the hips down to mid-calf.
Strappy gold-tone open-toe sandals with a 75mm block heel and ankle chain detail, #daae76, sleek finish complementing both the emerald and champagne tones.
Layered statement earrings featuring large faceted geometric shapes in smoky quartz and gold, #8f918d, paired with a slim black leather clutch for practicality.
This outfit works perfectly because the bold emerald velvet immediately captures attention and makes a memorable statement on the New Year's celebration. The champagne metallic skirt adds warmth and elegance suitable for a casual restaurant setting while ensuring comfort through soft draping fabrics. Finally, the rich jewel tone of the top contrasts beautifully with her skin to ensure she stands out as requested without compromising on wearability.
